placements.why: Establishes the organization's tier for resilience, recovery strategies, and operational validation.
placements.title: Recovery Capability Grounded in Active Verification
placements.frame: How are system reliability and recovery capabilities continuously verified through scheduled operational drills?

placements.title: Rollback Capabilities Only Exist When Routinely Rehearsed
placements.frame: Does operational doctrine treat un-rehearsed recovery procedures as non-existent until verified by regular drill cadences?
placements.why: Quinton's executive directive mandates monthly rollback drills under the principle that an un-rehearsed rollback is not an actual capability.
